a red satin slip midi dress with thin straps and a straight neckline cut straight across above the bust, high enough to cover the bandeau completely; hem below the knees; the dress covers the briefs completely, also at the hips.

classic black patent pointed pumps with thin high heels, drawn ON her two feet. Shoes are the exception to the no-skin rule: draw each whole foot from the ankle down, i.e. the visible skin of the top of the foot and the ankle together with the shoe, so that this layer completely covers the doll's bare feet. The feet keep exactly the doll's skin colour, position and size; the shoes fit them.
